metadata.title: Candidate hypervelocity stars of spectral type G and K revisited

evidence.quote:
We were able
to derive proper motions for 14 of the 20 P14 candidates. For
the low Galactic latitude stars No. 5, 7, 8, and 10 we failed to
identify a suficiently large set of suitable background galaxies.
No. 1 and 11 sufered from crowding.

20 candidates
were found likely to be unbound, four of which at 3 and six at
2σ significance levels.
We present a revised analysis of the 20 candidate HVSs

P14 Nos. 1, 5, 7, 8, 10, and 11 belong to the same 20-star P14 candidate sample and were studied through the all-sample spectral reanalysis (T:p2-b3), but were excluded from the proper-motion/orbit analysis (T:p2-b8), so their present-day boundness is not reassessed here; they remain `follow_up` objects from the prior candidate list. The prior unbound candidacy of the P14 sample is stated at T:p1-b13.
